newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum to buy Colombia contractor.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum to buy Colombia contractor.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc said on Wednesday it agreed to acquire Ingeser de Colombia SA, a drilling and workover contractor, for an undisclosed sum.
The company said in a statement the Colombia-based contractor had 13 rigs -- seven drilling rigs and six workover rigs -- and would have revenues of about $18 million in 1996.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Ray Tolson said the acquisition would triple Pride's operations in Colombia.
"Our combined fleet will be the largest in the country for intermediate depth drilling and workover, and we should realize significant consolidation benefits," he said.
